title: Anomalous Hall effect in anisotropic type-II Weyl semimetals
summary: We extend our previous analysis [Phys. Rev. D 109, 065005 (2024)] of CPT-odd electromagnetic response in tilted, anisotropic Weyl semimetals to the overtilted (type-II) regime, where electron and hole pockets coexist at the Fermi level. Starting from the minimal QED sector of the Standard-Model Extension matched to a lattice-motivated anisotropic Dirac Hamiltonian with tilt, we compute the zero-temperature finite-density effective action nonperturbatively from the vacuum polarization tensor, and corroborate the result using a complementary chiral kinetic theory formulation that consistently…
